purpose: Teach: コレクター/木工/かなえ/ロマンス

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお客様、本気で、絶対、コレクター、絶対、なのよ
lines.en: Sho — one of my customers is actually a serious collector. Like, the real deal.
lines.style: Warm, slightly conspiratorial. Leaning in to share something she's noticed. Conversational pace, like she's genuinely delighted by the observation. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、木工、絶対、頑張りたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis — I really, truly want to keep trying at woodwork. Like, I mean it.
lines.style: Quiet but certain underneath. A small boy being serious about something that matters to him. Not loud—just steady. Like he's confessing something important to someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達の、本気で、絶対、かなえ、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、可愛いよね、本気for
lines.en: Sho — your friend Kanae is really cute, isn't she? I've noticed.
lines.style: Gentle, teasing but not unkind. Soft on the observation—like she's noticed what he might not have admitted yet. Warm, not mocking. The tone of someone who sees and holds what others are shy about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ママ、本気で、絶対、ロマンス、絶対、映画、絶対、好きなんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Mom really loves those romance movies, doesn't she? She watches them all the time.
lines.style: Quiet reflection, observant. Not a complaint—just noticing something true about the people around him. Gentle, like he's thinking out loud with someone safe. Slow, almost wondering.
